issue_context.title: Proximity distance shows distance from center instead of border of the zone
issue_context.body:
### The problem

**Current behaviour**: The proximity distance calculation does not take the size of the zone into account. The [current code](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/0ffbe076beb9c9a0016cb9e6423fdcfce4440e43/homeassistant/components/proximity/coordinator.py#L167) takes the distance to the center of the zone, not the borders. I would argue that this is not intuitive and contradicts the documentation which says "a sensor is created showing the distance from the monitored zone". Further, considering a zone could fairly large, these could be differences that actually make a difference for some users.

**Expected behaviour**: The distance sensor should be showing the distance to the zone. Since zones are circular, it could simply be adjusted to `max(distance_to_zone_centre - zone_radius, 0)`.

Let me know if further information is required or helpful. If this is a good first issue, I am happy to open a PR.

core-2025.2.2
